ns2:course.label: Seminar on Security
ns2:course.description: Preparation of reports on a set of introductory lectures and student choices from various on-campus seminar series relevant to technology of domestic and international security and the regional and international contexts that influence the nature of security problems. Same as GLBL 483. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 2 hours. Prerequisite: Composition I.
